rules.title: Residential rental property application fee cap
rules.quote: A landlord, or agent thereof, shall not require an application or other similar fee to apply to lease or sublease a residential rental property for dwelling purposes, which exceeds $50.
rules.summary: Landlords cannot charge more than $50 for an application fee to lease or sublease a residential rental property.
rules.effective_date_evidence: Approved January 20, 2026. This act shall take effect on the first day of the fourth month next following the date of enactment
rules.exemption_note: Does not apply to dwelling units in one-family or two-family dwellings offered for rent, or to real estate licensees unless they are the landlord.
rules.penalty: Up to $500 for first offense, up to $750 for second offense, and up to $1,000 for each subsequent offense. Amount wrongfully charged shall be remitted to the applicant or prospective tenant.
